content.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500 slip, Nasdaq snaps three-day losing streak as Tesla climbs to record
content.summary: Investors reacted to the delayed release of the November jobs report, seen as pivotal to the path of interest rates next year.

content.title: US adds 64K jobs in November, Ford navigates $19.5B hit from EV pivot
Ford to take $19.5 billion hit in move away from EVs: What to know
Ford takes $19.5B charge in hybrid pivot, cancels F-150 Lightning EV, launches new battery storage business
content.summary: Ford announced a series of moves in its EV business, including pivoting to a hybrid and extended-range EV strategy instead of full EVs and taking a whopping $19.5 billion in charges related to the move.

content.title: Stocks to Watch Tuesday Recap: Ford Motor, Broadcom, Lennar
content.summary: 🔎 Ford Motor (F): The automaker expects about $19.5 billion in charges as it scales back electric-vehicle ambitions and shifts focus to gas-powered and hybrid vehicles. Shares closed slightly higher but edged lower after hours.

content.title: Heard on the Street Recap: Late Jobs Report Still Leaves a Mark
content.summary: In a report delayed by the government shutdown, the Labor Department said Tuesday that the unemployment rate rose to 4.6% in November--it’s highest level in more than four years.  The Dow and S&P 500 closed the day in the red, despite gains by most of the megacap tech stocks.  The Dow fell 302 points, or 0.6%.

content.title: What Ford’s Massive Charge Means for GM and Toyota
content.summary: Investors can expect asset write-downs and new plans from auto makers that leaned a little too hard into the trend. Curiously, that shouldn’t be a headwind for their stocks in 2026.

content.title: Tesla Stock Rises to First Record of 2025
content.summary: Shares of EV-maker Tesla rose 3.1% Tuesday to their first record since last December. The price move, which pushed the stock to $489.88, gave the company run by Elon Musk a market cap of $1.629 trillion, according to Dow Jones Market Data.

content.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Slides, Nasdaq Positive After Jobs Data; Nvidia Rises (Live Coverage)
content.summary: Stock Market Today: The Dow Jones index dropped Tuesday after a surprise November jobs report. Palantir and Tesla traded lower.

content.title: These Stocks Moved the Most Today: Tesla, Pfizer, Humana, Circle, CoreWeave, Broadcom, IonQ, Ford, Navan, and More
content.summary: Stocks were mixed Tuesday as U.S. hiring in November was stronger than expected and the unemployment rate jumped to 4.6%.  Ford  was up 0.2%.  The auto maker announced a pivot toward hybrids and away from electric cars.

content.title: Ford Stock Is Up. The Scary News Is Actually a ‘Bold Action.’
content.summary: Investors have reacted well to news of $19.5 billion in charges and a pivot away from all-electric cars.

content.title: Why Rivian (RIVN) Shares Are Falling Today
content.summary: Shares of electric vehicle manufacturer Rivian (NASDAQ:RIVN) fell 5.1% in the afternoon session after its competitor Ford announced a major pullback from its electric vehicle (EV) strategy, which amplified investor concerns about waning consumer demand and the financial health of the EV market.
